scripture.summary: After the death of Moses, the LORD commissions Joshua to lead Israel across the Jordan. Joshua commands the officers to prepare the people for the crossing.

mission.briefing: Guide Joshua through the camp and report to the officers of Israel as preparations begin to cross the Jordan.
mission.starterCode:
# Guide Joshua through the camp.
hero.moveRight()

designNotes: Keep the camp open and readable rather than corridor-like.
Place tents mainly around the edges and use only a few natural obstacles.
Preserve visual continuity toward the Jordan for later levels.
Level 1 uses one eastward move followed by one southward move so the first victory demonstrates execution order and a two-command sequence.
